summary: Link to the live Simon game so the learner can try it before building it.

concepts.heading: What to do
points: Open the hosted demo of the Simon game (londonappbrewery.github.io/Simon-Game) and play a few rounds first.
Watch the pattern: the game flashes one colour with a sound, you repeat it, then it adds one more colour each level; a wrong click ends the game.
(Extra) Note the details you will need to reproduce: title text changes per level, buttons flash/animate when pressed, red flash on game over, any key restarts.
